why_best: This dynamic reveals the system's thought process as it happens, instilling deep confidence in the real-time accuracy of the underlying data.
why_bad: A passive opacity dissolve or static pop-in treats high-value telemetry like a cached document, stripping away the sense of immediate, live backend activity.
trap: Allowing the leading focal marker to lose its strict synchronization with the emerging text, which instantly destroys the illusion of automated line execution.
